name: ESP32-S3 Blinky
description: ESP32-S3 DevKitC: blinks an LED on GPIO38 (%Q0.0) every 500 ms with a scan counter. The pin is the one in the current firmware/app/boards/esp32s3_devkitc_esp32s3_procpu.overlay; that overlay was tuned for a LilyGo T-Display S3, so the ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 pin mapping is pending.
author: ZPLC Team

outputs.name: LED_Output
outputs.description: GPIO38 per the current overlay (led0): wire an LED with a series resistor to GND. DevKitC-1 mapping pending.
